Our guest house features 4 cozy rooms , which can accommodate 6 to 8 guests at the same time. You'll find us just two minutes away from the charming West Lake in Tay Ho , surrounded by beautiful nature and a vibrant atmosphere. Location Female dormatory Why choose Us We work hard every day to make life of our guests better and happier French elegance Stay in a French-style home that adds a touch of romance and elegance to your accommodation. Lakeside Access Conveniently situated just a minute's walk from a beautiful lake, perfect for peaceful walks and enjoying nature. Heritage Tours We organize tours to nearby historical sites, museums and attractions. Sustainable Comfort Sleep well on eco-friendly, modern beds that ensure comfort while respecting the environment. Full Service Benefit from a wide range of services including delicious local foods, efficient housekeeping, and free Wi-Fi. Exceptional Hospitality Experience our commitment to warm and attentive service, making your stay as enjoyable as possible. Our services and advantages We try to give you a good mood and maximum comfort during your vacation. Bus Tickets and Motorbike Rentals You can conveniently book bus tickets and rent motorbikes directly at our homestay for easy and flexible travel. TV+PC Television and computer in common area Food and Bar You are free to make some tea and coffee or can order delicious breakfasts, lunches, and dinners directly at our homestay Wi-fi There is a free wi-fi connection in all the house Private garden Quiet garden in the courtyard of the house with a barbecue area Laundry Enjoy our convenient laundry service for a fresh and hassle-free stay. Quiet stay There is a very good additional insulation Experience tours & travel desk You can take advantage of our tours and travel desk for organizing exciting excursions and trips.
